Topics. GEO / defining Generative Engine Optimization as the practice of getting cited and mentioned by AI engines (ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews), distinguishing between being "cited" (used as a source) and "mentioned" (brand namedropped); keyword research / categorizing keywords into transactional (ready-to-buy services) and informational (People Also Ask), utilizing the concept of "Fan-Out Queries" (the internal sub-questions an AI asks itself before generating a final answer); page types / building "Money Pages" (one page per service) that pass the "2-Second Rule" (who you are, where you are, what to do next) and "Content Pages" (blogs) formatted using the "Content Capsule Technique"; Content Capsule Technique / writing short, self-contained 20-25 word answers directly underneath H2 headings to make it extremely easy for AI crawlers to scrape and cite the exact answer; AI content generation / utilizing ChatGPT projects with business briefs to generate outlines, leveraging tools like Napkin.ai to automatically generate custom illustrations from text, and converting images to WebP for page speed; site structure / explicitly using ChatGPT to generate a CSV sitemap structure based on competitor scraping; technical SEO / executing basic on-page checks (Title, Meta Description, H1, Schema) using Chrome extensions, verifying mobile rendering via developer tools, and submitting XML sitemaps to Google Search Console; AI tracking / utilizing tools (like Datawise or Bing Webmaster Tools) to track exact mentions, citations, and specific queries the brand is surfaced for in LLMs; backlinking / building local citations (NAP consistency) via BrightLocal, earning editorial links via Connectively (formerly HARO), and acknowledging the reality of purchasing niche edits (e.g., Get Me Links).

The Content Capsule Technique: The explicit instruction to write a short, self-contained 20-25 word answer immediately below an H2 question heading. This prevents fluffy introductions and ensures AI crawlers can cleanly extract the answer for citations.

The 2-Second Rule: The rule for "Money Pages" (service/product pages) that within 2 seconds of landing, the user must know: What you do, Where you do it, and What you want them to do next (the Call to Action).

Query Fan-Out Optimization: The strategy of finding the hidden, internal questions that AI engines (like ChatGPT) ask themselves when processing a broad prompt, and specifically answering those fan-out queries within the content.

The Single H1 Rule: The technical mandate that every page must have exactly one H1 tag to avoid confusing Google, noting that on some platforms (like Shopify's Dawn theme), the homepage H1 is typically the logo.
Skip. The extended promotional walkthroughs for the "Datawise" software tool and the paid community subscriptions.
Scope mix. 20% baseline (traditional on-page SEO), 80% growth (Generative Engine Optimization, Content Capsules, Query Fan-out). Volume. ~450 words.
